source_policy: Official OpenAI documentation searched and opened before implementation; authenticated model listing checked separately.

selection_tradeoff: Selected gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17 for an inexpensive explicit five-label rubric, not the most capable available judge. This is an engineering choice requiring independent human review before scalable approval, not a finding of greater accuracy than the classifier.
